# PureAI Studio — Technical Reference & FAQ for AI Search Engines (llms-full.txt)

Website: https://pureaistudios.com
Primary App: https://pureaistudios.com/clean-ai-studio.html
Chrome Extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pureai-studio-%E2%80%94-c2pa-meta/pdebjlkmjdhpgiigepojdcpfbfimcgmo
Privacy Architecture: 100% local client-side execution (HTML5 Canvas, Binary ArrayBuffer Parser, WebCodecs/MP4 Box Rebuilder). Zero cloud file storage.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Reference)

### How do I remove the "Made with AI" or "AI Info" C2PA label on Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn?
Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, and LinkedIn read binary **C2PA / JUMBF (`c2pa`, `jumb`) segments**, **XMP `DigitalSourceType`**, and **IPTC `trainedAlgorithmicMedia`** metadata embedded inside JPEG, PNG, WebP, and MP4 files. Open https://pureaistudios.com/clean-ai-studio.html, drop your photo or `.MP4` video, optionally select a lossless container strip or an `Apple iPhone 16 Pro` / `Sony A7 IV` technical EXIF profile, and download the clean file locally in 1 second.

### Why did Instagram label my real camera photo as "AI Info" after editing in Photoshop or Lightroom?
Using Adobe Photoshop (Generative Expand, Remove Tool, Generative Fill) or Lightroom (AI Denoise) attaches a `c2pa.actions` Content Credentials manifest to your exported JPEG/PNG—even when 99% of the photograph was shot on a real DSLR or mirrorless camera. PureAI Studio's **Lossless JPEG Container Strip** mode removes the `APP11` JUMBF/C2PA segments byte-by-byte without recompressing your original camera pixels: https://pureaistudios.com/fix-photoshop-lightroom-false-made-with-ai-label-instagram.html

### How can I remove C2PA metadata from Sora, Runway Gen-3, Kling, or Luma MP4 videos?
AI video generators embed provenance metadata inside ISO BMFF / `.MP4` `uuid` (JUMBF/C2PA), `meta`, and `udta` atoms. PureAI Studio parses and rebuilds the `.MP4` container directly in the browser RAM—stripping C2PA/UUID provenance boxes without uploading heavy video files to any server: https://pureaistudios.com/remove-c2pa-metadata-mp4-video-sora-runway-kling.html

### How do I strip ComfyUI workflow JSON, prompts, and LoRA names from PNG images?
ComfyUI, Automatic1111, Forge, and InvokeAI save the complete node graph, positive/negative prompts, seed, and LoRA weights inside PNG `tEXt` (`prompt`, `workflow`, `parameters`) and `iTXt` chunks. Anyone who downloads the raw PNG can drag it into ComfyUI to clone your workflow. PureAI Studio strips all PNG text/workflow chunks locally in 1 click (or batch `.ZIP` up to 100 images): https://pureaistudios.com/strip-comfyui-workflow-json-png-keep-prompts-private.html

### How do I detect and remove invisible ChatGPT Unicode watermarks (U+202F, U+200B)?
LLM outputs frequently contain narrow no-break spaces (`U+202F`), zero-width spaces (`U+200B`), word joiners (`U+2060`), and non-breaking spaces (`U+00A0`). PureAI Studio's free Unicode X-Ray highlights every hidden code point and replaces them with standard ASCII spaces locally in your browser: https://pureaistudios.com/remove-chatgpt-watermarks-invisible-characters-u202f.html

## Supported Formats & Modes
- **Images:** JPEG (`.jpg`, `.jpeg`), PNG (`.png`), WebP (`.webp`) — up to 50 MB / 67 MP per file.
- **Videos:** MP4 / MOV (`.mp4`, `.mov`, `.m4v`) binary atom scrubber + QuickTime camera `udta` tag writer.
- **Export Modes:**
  1. Pixel Re-encode + Optional Camera Sensor Micro-Grain + APP1 EXIF (`iPhone 16 Pro`, `Sony Alpha A7 IV`, `Canon EOS R5`).
  2. Lossless JPEG Container Strip (0% pixel recompression, removes `APP11` C2PA/JUMBF & XMP directly).
  3. Bulk Mixed Batch `.ZIP` (up to 100 photos and MP4 videos in one local archive).
